name: java-kernel
description: Installs a Java Jupyter kernel (IJava) from release or submodule and registers kernelspec.

KERNEL_VERSION.description: Kernel release version to download when using 'release' source (e.g. v1.4.5)

ARTIFACTS_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for release artefacts (e.g. GitHub releases base)

postInstallCheck.command: bash -lc 'if [ -d /usr/local/share/jupyter/kernels/java ]; then exit 0; else jupyter kernelspec list --json | python -c "import sys,json; ks=json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"kernelspecs\",{}); sys.exit(0) if \"java\" in ks else sys.exit(1)"; fi'
